# aap_workflow_job_template_notification_template_success (Resource)

Associate notification template(s) to a workflow job template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aap_workflow_job_template_notification_template_success" "example" {
  workflow_job_template_id = 100
  notif_template_ids       = [1, 2]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `notif_template_ids` (Set of Number) An unordered list of `Automation Controller_notification_template` IDs associated to a particular Workflow Job Template.
- `workflow_job_template_id` (String) The ID of the containing Workflow Job Template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import aap_workflow_job_template_notification_template_success.example 100
```
